t: Section 513 of division F of Public Law 114–113, regarding a prohibition on funding for any position designated as a Principal Federal Official, shall apply with respect to funds made available in this Act in the same manner as such section applied to funds made available in that Act.

fable.w: This section only carries forward an earlier appropriations restriction that bars funding for a federal position. The tempting reading is that the incorporated section might contain some consultation requirement, but nothing in this text requires or invites consultation, comment, hearings, advisory bodies, or suits involving anyone outside the federal government. It is a purely internal funding limitation.
fable.s: regarding a prohibition on funding for any position designated as a Principal Federal Official

qwen_block.w: This section is a technical provision extending a funding prohibition from a previous law to the current act. It deals exclusively with federal appropriations and the designation of federal positions. There is no mention of consultation, coordination, or interaction with any non-federal entities, such as states, tribes, the public, or private organizations.
qwen_block.s: Section 513 of division F of Public Law 114–113, regarding a prohibition on funding for any position designated as a Principal Federal Official, shall apply with respect to funds made available in this Act in the same manner as such section applied to funds made available in that Act.

opus.w: This is an appropriations rule that carries forward a ban on funding a particular federal position. It involves no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body or right to sue for anyone outside the federal government. The words "Principal Federal Official" name a federal job and have nothing to do with outside participation.
opus.s: regarding a prohibition on funding for any position designated as a Principal Federal Official, shall apply with respect to funds made available in this Act

It does not establish any process for consulting with or coordinating with parties outside the federal government. The mention of a 'Principal Federal Official' refers to a federal employee role, and the text only restricts funding for that role, rather than mandating interaction with external stakeholders.
qwen_chat.s: Section 513 of division F of Public Law 114–113, regarding a prohibition on funding for any position designated as a Principal Federal Official, shall apply with respect to funds made available in this Act in the same manner as such section applied to funds made available in that Act.
